description: This file defines the 'Statistics' controller class in the OpenCart admin module, handling event-driven methods related to reviews and returns, and updating corresponding statistics.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: A controller class in the OpenCart admin module for handling statistical updates related to reviews and returns triggered by specific events.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Handles the event after a review is added and updates the review count in statistics.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Handles the event after a review is deleted and updates the review count in statistics.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Handles the event after a return is added and updates the return count in statistics.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Handles the event after a return is deleted and updates the return count in statistics.
